title: Shocking Change in the Forbidden Grounds
next_chapter_hook: Zhang Shen collapsed to the ground, voice trembling: "I... it was Sect Master Ling Yuan who made me do it..." Chen Ji's gaze instantly turned icy cold, his fingertips tapping lightly on the Tianji Record. On the chessboard of fate, another pawn had been added.

text.content: The eerie glow deep within the Forbidden Grounds squirmed like a living thing. The Tianji Record Fragment floated before Chen Ji's chest, emanating a faint bronze luster. The ancient seal characters flickered between clarity and obscurity, as if guiding toward some direction. "Master, this path..." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul probed from the book pages, voice carrying worry, "Ahead there are extremely powerful barrier formations, and not just one." Chen Ji did not answer, merely tucking the fragment back into his sleeve and stepping forward. His gaze was calm to the point of being cold—since he had come, there was no turning back.

dialogue.content: "There are ambushes, and the person who set up the formation is not of low cultivation. At the very least, Foundation Building late stage." Mo Xiansheng's phantom flickered unstably. "Be careful in your actions, don't stir up the hornet's nest."

text.content: The tunnel opened suddenly into a vast underground stone chamber. The stone walls were covered with faded runes, emanating a ghostly green light. At the center stood a three-zhang tall bronze altar, with a yellowed silk scroll suspended at its peak. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled intensely again, seemingly resonating with that silk scroll from afar. "Sure enough, it's here..." Chen Ji murmured softly, a flash of sharpness crossing his eyes. At the same time, his divine sense quietly spread out, taking in the entire chamber's layout.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, the aura here is strange," Su Qingyao gripped her sword hilt tightly, her beautiful eyes filled with vigilance. "I always feel someone secretly watching us."

text.content: Before the words finished, the runes on all four walls of the chamber suddenly blazed to life, blinding green light interweaving into a dense, impenetrable net. Then, a withered figure stepped out from the shadows through the air, blocking the way to the altar. It was Elder Zhang Shen of the Tianqing Sect. "Waste of a disciple," Zhang Shen stroked his beard, his face wore an amiable smile, but his eyes were as cold and sinister as a snake's. "This old man has been waiting for you for quite some time." Behind him, more than a dozen black shadows manifested from the rune formation, encircling Chen Ji and Su Qingyao completely.

dialogue.content: "Elder Zhang has come here late at night," Chen Ji tilted his head slightly, his tone as flat as if discussing the weather. "Could it be you've also come to admire the moon? Unfortunately, there is no moon here."

Su Qingyao placed her sword horizontally before Chen Ji, her voice cold: "Elder Zhang, what is the meaning of this? Sect orders forbid unauthorized entry to the Forbidden Grounds. You lead people to encircle a disciple—what is your intention?"

"Ha ha!" Zhang Shen burst into laughter, the sound filled with contempt. "Forbidden ground prohibition? This old man has been in the sect for dozens of years, when has he ever feared any prohibition? Today, none of you shall leave alive."

text.content: Chen Ji looked at Zhang Shen's hypocritical face, a cold smile forming in his heart. He slowly closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking into the Mental Sea. Eye of Breakthrough, second layer—breakthrough! In an instant, densely packed golden threads appeared in his pupils, those were the energy pathways of the formation array. Zhang Shen's arranged barrier formation was completely revealed before his eyes—thirty-six weak points, every node's energy flow clearly visible. "So that's how it is," Chen Ji opened his eyes, a meaningful arc curving at the corner of his mouth. "Elder Zhang's formation attainments seem to still have much room for improvement."

Zhang Shen's expression changed slightly, then he grinned wickedly: "At death's door still acting mysterious! Attack!" More than a dozen black-clothed men simultaneously activated the rune formation, green barrier light surging toward Chen Ji like a tide. However, at this moment, Chen Ji moved. His form was like a specter shuttling through the rune formation, each flicker precisely striking a weak point. First one—rune lines snapped; second—nodes collapsed; third, fourth... In just three breaths, all thirty-six weak points erupted, and the massive barrier formation collapsed with a thunderous crash!

choice.prompt: The barriers collapsed, Zhang Shen's face turned deathly pale, more than a dozen black-clothed men were thrown into chaos. Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, his gaze sharp as a blade, staring directly at Zhang Shen. Kill decisively, or spare his life for detailed questioning?

choices.description: Kill Zhang Shen on the spot to eliminate future troubles and serve as a warning to others.
choices.visible_reward: Shock the entire audience, news will not leak
choices.risk_hint: May lose clues to investigate the mastermind behind the scenes

text.content: A blade of cold light flew from Chen Ji's sleeve—that was Mo Xiansheng's last sealed sword qi. The sword qi pierced through the air, carrying a chilling killing intent, heading directly for Zhang Shen's throat. Zhang Shen's pupils constricted sharply, wanting to dodge but already too late—psssh! Blood splashed, this elder who had been hypocritical for decades didn't even manage to scream before being decapitated.

choices.description: Break his resistance, capture Zhang Shen, and pry more intelligence from his mouth.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence about the mastermind
choices.risk_hint: Zhang Shen may desperation or someone may come to silence him

text.content: Chen Ji raised his hand, spiritual energy forming chains that bound Zhang Shen's four limbs. "You... you can't kill me!" Zhang Shen struggled in terror, only to find his entire cultivation completely sealed. "Kill you?" Chen Ji walked over slowly, his voice ice-cold. "Elder Zhang seems to have misunderstood something. I only want to know—who gave you the guts to touch someone belonging to Chen Ji."

Zhang Shen's face was ashen, his legs went weak and he knelt on the ground. "Chen Ji... no, Young Master Chen, spare my life!" He no longer had the earlier arrogance, sweat pouring down his face like rain. "This old man was merely confused for a moment, seduced by others..." Chen Ji looked down at him from above, then suddenly spoke: "The inner armor Elder Zhang is wearing is woven from unique Demonic Path Xuancan Silk, isn't it?" Zhang Shen shuddered all over, a flash of panic crossing his face. Chen Ji continued: "There are also residual traces of Demonic Path cultivation technique on your sleeves. If I guessed correctly, it should be the handiwork of the Yaming Sect. Elder Zhang has collaborated with the Demonic Path, evidence is conclusive—any final words?"

The chamber fell into dead silence. Su Qingyao watched Chen Ji's back as he calmly revealed the truth, a complex glint flashing in her beautiful eyes. When did this waste of a disciple become so terrifying? Those clues she had searched desperately for, he saw through them all with just one glance. "There's one more thing," Chen Ji squatted down, eye level with Zhang Shen. "How did you set up this series of rune formations in the Forbidden Grounds? Without an insider, you alone couldn't have done it. Speak—who is backing you?" Zhang Shen's lips trembled, the veins on his forehead bulging, clearly engaged in intense mental struggle.

"I..." Zhang Shen gritted his teeth, beads of sweat dripping from his temples. "Elder Zhang," Chen Ji's voice floated lightly, yet carried bone-deep coldness. "You should know, I have plenty of ways to make you speak. But at that point, the result won't be as dignified as now." He casually picked up the scattered talisman paper on the ground, playing with it nonchalantly. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul timely reminded: "Master, this type of spineless one, using some special techniques would save trouble. For instance, Soul-Searching Technique. Although there are side effects, for someone whose foundations are already destroyed, it's harmless."

choice.prompt: Zhang Shen fell into despair. Give him a final chance to confess willingly, or directly employ means to force a confession?

choices.description: Give him one chance to voluntarily confess, showing mercy to win hearts.
choices.visible_cost: The other party may resist desperately

dialogue.content: "Enough," Chen Ji sighed lightly, standing up. "Elder Zhang is at least a sect elder. I'll give you a chance. If you confess truthfully now, I guarantee you'll be left whole, and your family won't be implicated. How about it?"

choices.description: Apply Soul-Searching Technique, don't waste time, directly obtain intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes energy, may have slight backlash
choices.visible_reward: Ensure intelligence is obtained, cut the gordian knot
choices.risk_hint: May cause slight damage to the soul

text.content: Chen Ji did not waste another word, condensing a wisp of ghostly-blue spiritual consciousness light at his fingertip, directly pressing it to Zhang Shen's Brow Center. "Ah—!" A miserable shriek echoed through the chamber, Zhang Shen's eyes flew wide open, blood seeping from all seven orifices. Under the forced reading of the Soul-Searching Technique, every secret in his soul was laid bare. Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly—he saw a name, a figure he had long suspected but never confirmed.

Zhang Shen collapsed limply to the ground, voice trembling: "I... it was Sect Master Ling Yuan who made me do it..." Chen Ji's gaze instantly turned ice-cold, fingertips tapping lightly on the Tianji Record. On the chessboard of fate, another pawn had been added. The silk scroll on the altar suddenly burst forth with dazzling golden light, and Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value fluctuate violently—the greatest fortune belonging to this scroll seemed to be right before his eyes. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his ear: "Master, the time has come. The next page of the Tianji Record lies within that silk scroll."

"Ling Yuan..." When Su Qingyao heard this name, her beautiful face instantly turned pale. She unconsciously gripped her sword hilt tighter, her knuckles white. That was the Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, the highest authority of the entire sect! If what Chen Ji said was true, then the sect's interior had long been riddled with holes. Her gaze toward Chen Ji changed, carrying a solemnity never seen before: "Chen Ji, this matter... what do you intend to do?" Chen Ji did not answer, merely gazing quietly at that suspended silk scroll, his eyes deep and unfathomable. After a long while, he said softly: "Junior Sister Qingyao, as for today's events, just pretend you saw and heard nothing."

Su Qingyao abruptly raised her head, her beautiful eyes filled with shock and confusion. She opened her mouth, wanting to say something, yet not knowing where to begin. This waste of a disciple, who had just uncovered the sect's greatest conspiracy, yet chose to bear the burden alone? "You..." her voice somewhat choked. "What kind of person do you take me, Su Qingyao, for?" Chen Ji turned his head back, looking at her earnest expression, then suddenly smiled. That smile was still gentle, yet carried an inexplicable meaning: "Junior Sister's kindness, Chen Ji gratefully acknowledges. However, the road ahead—I walk it alone is fine." With that, he turned
